name: What role does a real estate agent play in the pre-construction closing process?

mainEntity.name: What role does a real estate agent play in the pre-construction closing process?

acceptedAnswer.text: A real estate agent plays a crucial role in the pre-construction closing process by representing your interests, negotiating terms with the builder, reviewing contracts, and guiding you through each stage. They can help you understand market conditions, recommend lenders and attorneys, and ensure deadlines are met. For clients in South Florida, an agent like Kelby Contreras can offer first-party insight into specific builder practices and assist with navigating potential challenges unique to the local market, ensuring a smoother transaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: A real estate agent represents your interests, negotiates terms, and guides you through each stage of the pre-construction closing process.
